description: Watch a brand or a keyword on the user's MyGroceryPal account, so they hear when a matching product goes on offer. Needs the user's MyGroceryPal account.

kind.description: 'brand' follows every product of one brand; 'keyword' matches product names

minSavingsPercent.description: Smallest saving worth an alert, in percent. Defaults to 15.

term.description: The brand name or keyword, e.g. 'Cadbury' or 'oat milk'

name: create_deal_alert
title: Create a deal alert
